about: CC_SILVER_AARDWOLD_OPTIMIZED, the faster network of the 310.8 model (build_network.py <arch> --optimized; its own
weights): every pipeline of pipelines.json, "change" adds defines to the pipeline of that name, "new" builds extra
pipelines from a base pipeline of pipelines.json. With its int4 layers on: pipelines-int4.json.
NR_SACT=1: ReLU as the Swin MLP activation (every fswin_t pipeline but the pre block's), with MLP weights fitted for
it. NR_FIXP: the window attention of the decoder's layers 66, 67 and 70 is one fixed 64x64 probability table a layer
(no QK^T, no softmax); NR_VOMERGE: the V and output projections of a one-head layer as one matrix (66, 67, 70 with
NR_FIXP, 68 and 69 with their own softmax). fswin32d / fswin32nhd and fswin32v / fswin32nhv: layer 67 and layers
68, 69 on their own pipelines (the encoder's layers of the same kernels keep the full attention); "routes" names
the blocks (block-routes.txt for the host). NR_CONSTH: the C=512 attention heads the host proves constant
(const-heads.txt). fixed-attention.txt lists the NR_FIXP pipelines (the host writes their tables). The weights:
CC_SILVER_AARDWOLD_OPTIMIZED.bin, made at install from the model (linux/data/optimized). Temporal variants: pipelines.json.
